premises.text: Furniture buyers face high risk because they cannot visualize products in their own rooms
premises.evidence_span: today, furniture shopping is high risk

premises.text: Existing 3D modeling solutions are commercial tools that are too difficult, expensive, or slow for homeowners
premises.evidence_span: They're commercial solutions, so much so that less than 1% of homeowners use these 3D model solutions

premises.text: Inside Maps lets homeowners create usable 3D room models from a short smartphone scan processed into photorealistic WebGL scenes
premises.evidence_span: create a 3D model of their own home with just a smartphone

premises.text: Retailers connected to those home models can upsell accessories, reach new customers, and lower returns
premises.evidence_span: It will help them upsell to new accessories. It will also help them reach new customers, and it will lower their returns

value.text: Disrupt furniture shopping by making the home the ideal place to try furniture in 3D
value.evidence_span: disrupt the way we shop for furniture

causal_links.evidence_span: your home becomes the ideal place to shop for furniture

notes: Capture sensors, point-cloud GPU pipeline, structural detection, and collaboration UI folded into monolithic product premise P3 (v1.3.2 §4.1(5)). Market-size revolution claim treated as framing. Singletons D2/D3 retained.
